name: Sugita Reiko
source:
She wears glasses. She usually wears a tailored suit and a white coat. She’s a female doctor with a private practice near the apartment where Takeshi lives.

“Being a private practitioner isn’t easy, you know…” she says, clearly under a ton of stress. Her favorite foods are oden and sake.

She has a diet that’s more like an old man’s. During the day, she’s a cool, intelligent woman, but when it comes to sex, she gets incredibly clingy.
